title: CRC sees revenue increase by 5% in third quarter
desc: Central Retail Corporation Plc (CRC), a retailer and wholesaler in Thailand and Vietnam, reported total revenue of 61.1 billion baht in the third quarter, up 5% year-on-year, while its core profit from continuing operations surged by 72% to 2.05 billion baht, exceeding 2 billion baht for the third consecutive year.
title_cn: 中央零售公司第三季度营收增长5% 核心利润激增72%
summary_cn: 泰国中央零售公司(CRC)第三季度营收达611亿泰铢，同比增长5%。核心利润激增72%，达20.5亿泰铢，连续第三年突破20亿泰铢大关，反映该公司在泰国和越南市场的零售与批发业务表现强劲。
desc_original: Central Retail Corporation Plc (CRC), a retailer and wholesaler in Thailand and Vietnam, reported total revenue of 61.1 billion baht in the third quarter, up 5% year-on-year, while its core profit from continuing operations surged by 72% to 2.05 billion baht, exceeding 2 billion baht for the third consecutive year.

title: Can Social Security reforms save the fund?
desc: The sustainability problem facing the Social Security Fund could become a ticking time bomb for Thai society. The countdown has already begun. If nothing is done, the consequences could be severe. The Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) estimates that without a major overhaul of the Social Security Fund, its reserves could be depleted within the next 27 years.
title_cn: 社会保障基金改革能否拯救危局？
summary_cn: 泰国社会保障基金面临可持续性危机，泰国开发研究所(TDRI)警示，若不进行根本性改革，该基金储备将在未来27年内枯竭。当前形势紧迫，需立即采取行动以避免对泰国社会造成严重后果。
desc_original: The sustainability problem facing the Social Security Fund could become a ticking time bomb for Thai society. The countdown has already begun. If nothing is done, the consequences could be severe. The Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) estimates that without a major overhaul of the Social Security Fund, its reserves could be depleted within the next 27 years.

title: Abhisit urges clarity in Shuffle probe
desc: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has urged the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to handle the Shuffle.com inquiry transparently, warning that a lack of clarity could undermine public confidence.
title_cn: 阿比昔促 Shuffle 调查透明化
summary_cn: 民主党领导人阿比昔·维集瓦表示，特别调查部门（DSI）在处理 Shuffle.com 查询案时应保持透明，强调缺乏清晰的调查流程和公开说明将严重损害公众对司法部门的信任。他呼吁相关部门提供更详细的案情进展通报。
desc_original: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has urged the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to handle the Shuffle.com inquiry transparently, warning that a lack of clarity could undermine public confidence.

title: Microsoft outage spurs cybersecurity review
desc: The government has ordered an urgent review of cybersecurity preparedness across critical sectors following a widespread global disruption to Microsoft's services.
title_cn: 微软服务中断引发网络安全审查
summary_cn: 泰国政府鉴于微软服务全球大规模中断事件，下令对金融、电力、电信、交通运输等关键基础设施部门的网络安全防范能力进行紧急全面审查，确保国家重点部门的数字安全防护体系完善。
desc_original: The government has ordered an urgent review of cybersecurity preparedness across critical sectors following a widespread global disruption to Microsoft's services.

title: Skills shortage threatens Thailand's nuclear goals
desc: Although Thailand aims to introduce small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) by 2037, experts warn that the biggest challenge is developing the thousands of qualified specialists needed to operate and regulate them safely, a process that could take a decade.
title_cn: 专业人才短缺威胁泰国核能目标
summary_cn: 泰国计划 2037 年前引进小型模块化核反应堆（SMRs）以应对能源需求，但业界人士指出最大挑战在于须培养数千名合格专业人员来安全运营和监管核设施，这个培养过程预计需耗时十年左右。
desc_original: Although Thailand aims to introduce small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) by 2037, experts warn that the biggest challenge is developing the thousands of qualified specialists needed to operate and regulate them safely, a process that could take a decade.

title: Asean return eyed for FM
desc: Myanmar's foreign minister should be allowed back into Asean meetings, Thailand's top diplomat said on Thursday after visiting the war-torn country.
title_cn: 缅甸外长有望重返东盟会议

desc_original: Myanmar's foreign minister should be allowed back into Asean meetings, Thailand's top diplomat said on Thursday after visiting the war-torn country.

title: River pollution talks expedited
desc: Thailand and Myanmar have agreed to bring forward a joint working group meeting on cross-border river pollution to Nov 25-26, as both countries seek urgent measures to tackle worsening contamination in the Kok and Sai rivers, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said on Friday.
title_cn: 跨界河流污染谈判加速推进
summary_cn: 泰国与缅甸协议将跨界河流污染联合工作组会议提前至 11 月 25-26 日召开，以应对廓河（Kok）和赛河（Sai）等边境河流污染恶化问题。两国外交部门宣布将采取紧急措施共同应对这一跨界环境危机。
desc_original: Thailand and Myanmar have agreed to bring forward a joint working group meeting on cross-border river pollution to Nov 25-26, as both countries seek urgent measures to tackle worsening contamination in the Kok and Sai rivers, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said on Friday.

title: Central Embassy to develop into super-luxury landmark

desc_original: Central Group and Central Pattana Plc will jointly invest more than 83 billion baht to transform Central Embassy into a super-luxury mixed-use landmark in central Bangkok.

title: 'Thai Rath' publisher dies
desc: Khunying Praneetsilpa Vacharaphol, chair of Vacharaphol Co Ltd and publisher of Thai Rath, Thailand's largest-selling daily newspaper, has died aged 94.
title_cn: 「泰国日报」出版人去世
summary_cn: 泰国发行量最大日报「Thai Rath」的出版人及集团董事长昆英·普拉尼西尔帕·瓦查拉帕尔去世，享年 94 岁。作为泰国新闻出版业的重要人物和商业领袖，其离世对泰国媒体产业造成重大影响。
desc_original: Khunying Praneetsilpa Vacharaphol, chair of Vacharaphol Co Ltd and publisher of Thai Rath, Thailand's largest-selling daily newspaper, has died aged 94.

title: Household recycling 'won't fix crisis'
desc: Thailand's waste crisis cannot be solved by household recycling alone, experts warned, urging the government to advance comprehensive circular economy legislation that would spread responsibility for waste management beyond cash-strapped local authorities.
title_cn: 家庭回收「无法解决」垃圾危机
summary_cn: 专家警告，泰国的垃圾危机仅靠家庭回收无法彻底解决。各界呼吁政府推进全面的循环经济立法，完善垃圾分类管理体系，将环卫责任从预算困难的地方当局向生产商和企业扩展。
desc_original: Thailand's waste crisis cannot be solved by household recycling alone, experts warned, urging the government to advance comprehensive circular economy legislation that would spread responsibility for waste management beyond cash-strapped local authorities.

title: Central bank highlights uneven impact of AI boom
desc: The Bank of Thailand (BoT) is closely monitoring the global artificial intelligence (AI) investment boom, amid concerns that its benefits have yet to fully spill over into the Thai economy.
title_cn: 央行指出人工智能投资热潮影响不均
summary_cn: 泰国央行（BoT）密切关注全球人工智能投资热潮的发展，但担忧其经济效益尚未充分惠及泰国经济。泰国面临在 AI 浪潮中被边缘化的风险，需要制定相应政策确保本土企业和劳动力不被落下。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand (BoT) is closely monitoring the global artificial intelligence (AI) investment boom, amid concerns that its benefits have yet to fully spill over into the Thai economy.

title: Thai investigators ask Google and Apple to pull illegal loan apps
desc: Thai investigators ask Google and Apple to pull illegal loan apps Legacy Thai investigators have asked Google and Apple to remove illegal loan apps from their app stores in Thailand unless the apps belong to one of eight companies licensed by the Bank of Thailand, the agency said yesterday, November 13. The request targets unlicensed lenders accused of using borrowers’ phone contacts and photos to shame them into paying. The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) sent the list of the eight licensed digital personal loan providers to Google’s representative in Thailand and to Apple South Asia (Thailand) Co., Ltd. It asked both companies to check the loan apps on Google Play and the App Store against that list and to take down any app not run by one of the eight, so that more borrowers are not harmed. According to the DSI, the apps make borrowers allow access to the data on their phones, including saved phone numbers and photos, before they lend any money. title: Chiang Mai plans to become Thailand’s astronomy capital
desc: Chiang Mai plans to become Thailand’s astronomy capital Legacy Chiang Dao district in Chiang Mai is being developed as a stargazing destination under a joint initiative by the National Astronomical Research Institute of Thailand (NARIT) and the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT), which also aims to protect local natural resources and preserve dark skies. The plan was discussed at a meeting on November 10 at the Princess Sirindhorn AstroPark in Mae Rim district, chaired by Chiang Mai Deputy Governor Bunlue Thammatharanurak. Representatives from the Chiang Mai Provincial Administrative Organisation, the provincial tourism and sports office, the TAT’s Chiang Mai office, the Chiang Dao Tourism Operators Association, local authorities and the local dark sky network also attended. Photo via Chiang Mai News Participants discussed ways to develop sustainable tourism, strengthen local communities and establish Chiang Dao as a high-quality tourist destination. One part of the initiative is to promote astronomy tourism through an upcoming event, “Chiang Dao Geminid Hunting, Lights Off, Sky Open”, scheduled to take place from the evening of December 13 until the morning of Decembe

title: Thai finance minister warns of AI investment scams using his face
desc: Thai finance minister warns of AI investment scams using his face Legacy Thailand’s finance minister has revealed that scammers used AI-generated images of his face to promote investment schemes , warning the public not to trust advertisements featuring his likeness. Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said today, November 13 that he had filed a police complaint after discovering the fake advertisements, which used deepfake technology to make it appear as though he was encouraging people to invest. Ekniti said he was startled when he first saw the advertisements because the AI-generated images looked remarkably like him. He stressed that he had never promoted an investment scheme or invited anyone to invest. Ekniti also warned about mobile loan apps claiming to have the Ministry of Finance’s endorsement, stressing that the ministry had never endorsed such apps. He explained that financial apps are subject to oversight by the Bank of Thailand, while licence applications must also be reviewed by the Ministry of Finance. summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼财政部长埃克尼提·尼提坦帕帕表示，诈骗分子利用AI生成的其面孔照片推广投资计划。他已向警方提交举报，强调从未推广投资计划或邀请任何人投资。他还警告了冒充财政部认可的手机贷款应用，指出这类应用应受泰国央行监管，许可证申请也需通过财政部审查。此举反映泰国金融诈骗问题日益增加的现状。
desc_original: Thai finance minister warns of AI investment scams using his face Legacy Thailand’s finance minister has revealed that scammers used AI-generated images of his face to promote investment schemes , warning the public not to trust advertisements featuring his likeness. Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said today, November 13 that he had filed a police complaint after discovering the fake advertisements, which used deepfake technology to make it appear as though he was encouraging people to invest. Ekniti said he was startled when he first saw the advertisements because the AI-generated images looked remarkably like him. He stressed that he had never promoted an investment scheme or invited anyone to invest. Ekniti also warned about mobile loan apps claiming to have the Ministry of Finance’s endorsement, stressing that the ministry had never endorsed such apps. He explained that financial apps are subject to oversight by the Bank of Thailand, while licence applications must also be reviewed by the Ministry of Finance. title: Phuket waste crisis eases as landfill partially reopens
desc: Phuket waste crisis eases as landfill partially reopens Legacy Phuket ’s main waste disposal centre has partially reopened after an overflowing landfill forced it to stop accepting rubbish on November 8. Officials expect the facility to resume full operations next week . Phuket City Municipality announced the partial reopening on November 12, following a meeting chaired by Phuket Governor Chotnarin Kerdsom to address the island’s growing waste problem . Phuket City Mayor Supachok Laongphet said the landfill had been struggling with accumulated rubbish for years as waste volumes continued to rise following the Covid-19 pandemic. Waste disposal and landfill expansion projects are more than a year behind schedule due to regulatory hurdles, complaints, appeals and lawsuits. Limited machinery and heavy rain have also disrupted work at the site. The landfill stopped accepting rubbish on November 8 after trucks from several local administrations dumped waste that blocked access roads. title: Govt denies ignoring pollution concerns in Prachin Buri, Chachoengsao
desc: Govt denies ignoring pollution concerns in Prachin Buri, Chachoengsao Legacy The government denied ignoring pollution concerns in the Prachin Buri River Basin and surrounding areas, including Chachoengsao , saying it plans to propose designating affected locations as pollution control zones for further investigation and remedial measures. Dead fish floating in the Bang Pakong River in Chachoengsao prompted concern among residents and people who fish in the area. Residents fear the fish deaths could be linked to water contamination from the Prachin Buri River Basin, which is connected to the Bang Pakong River. However, no official investigation has established the cause or confirmed a connection between the two incidents. The pollution concerns in Prachin Buri date back to major flooding at the end of September. Residents noticed an oily film on the surface of floodwater . The material allegedly came from an industrial waste landfill in the province. Photo via Matichon Water test results showed contamination with petroleum hydrocarbons, excessive oil and grease, and several metals. Residents also reported developing itchy rashes and scabs after coming into contact with the water. Ri

summary_cn: 泰国政府否认忽视差春滨河流域污染问题，表示将受影响区域指定为污染控制区进行调查和补救。差春岛邦邦公河发现死鱼引发居民担忧，怀疑与上游差春滨河污染有关。水质测试显示含石油烃、过量油脂和多种金属污染。问题源于9月末严重洪灾，居民发现洪水表面有油膜，疑似来自当地工业废弃物填埋场。有民众因接触污水出现皮肤瘙痒结痂。

title: Foreign booking sites face Thai airfare caps after Chiang Mai fare spike
desc: Foreign booking sites face Thai airfare caps after Chiang Mai fare spike Legacy Thailand’s aviation regulator wants foreign booking sites to register in the country and follow the legal fare caps that already bind airlines. The request follows Chiang Mai flight tickets from Bangkok appearing above 20,000 baht ahead of the Yi Peng festival, which runs from November 23 to 26. Deputy Transport Minister Siripong Angkasakulkiat said yesterday, November 12, that he hopes the rules can be in place by next year. The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) has written to the Commerce Ministry asking for legislation that would require online travel agencies to register in Thailand and would let the government enforce maximum fares on them. Siripong told the CAAT to send its request without delay and suggested that the Commerce Ministry, the Transport Ministry and the Office of the Consumer Protection Board work on the rules together. summary_cn: 清迈Yi Peng灯节（11月23-26日）前夕，曼谷至清迈机票暴涨超20000泰铢，引发泰国民航局关注。民航局要求外国在线旅行社在泰注册并遵守对航空公司生效的法定票价上限，运输副部长希望相关规定明年落实。民航局已致函商业部要求立法强制执行，以便政府对这些通常为外国企业且未在泰注册的平台执行最高票价限制。

title: Swedish fraud suspect arrested in Pattaya after 352-day overstay
desc: Swedish fraud suspect arrested in Pattaya after 352-day overstay Legacy A Swedish man wanted in his home country for allegedly posing as a police officer to defraud victims was arrested in Pattaya after immigration police discovered he had overstayed his visa by 352 days . The suspect, identified as Lyon, was detained outside a hotel in central Pattaya at about 4.30pm yesterday, November 12, following a tip-off from the Nordic Police Liaison Office. Swedish officials had issued an arrest warrant for Lyon in connection with a fraud case involving the alleged impersonation of police officers. Photo via IMM Thailand According to immigration police, Lyon allegedly pretended to be a police officer to gain victims’ trust before persuading them to hand over money or valuables. Investigators said he subsequently left Sweden and travelled to Thailand, where he had been staying in Pattaya. After receiving information from the Nordic Police Liaison Office, the Immigration Bureau worked with Chon Buri Immigration Police to locate Lyon. Their enquiries led them to a hotel in Pattaya , where officers spotted a foreign man matching the description provided by their Nordic counterparts. Phot
